items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: the only one I know had a barber shop was Papa John.

ctx.x: I haven't seen, uh. How we doing on time? We got plenty? Yeah, I got more tape left. Yeah. What about the barbershops? Did many musicians work in the barbershops?
Not as I know, no, not that. Not many of them cut hair? No, the only one I know had a barber shop was Papa John.
Yeah. Thanks for that. They had a barber shop uptown. Yeah, what about Paul Dominguez? Do you remember Paul Dominguez?
